name: Colosseo Cucina Italiana
notes: read from the restaurant's own Squarespace dinner menu (tabbed sections). Prices for ANTIPASTI/PRIMI/SALADS AND SOUP/WOODFIRE PIZZA/MAIN COURSES read from paired currency-sign+decimal-sign spans (menu-item-price-top, duplicated in price-bottom, deduped). KIDS MENU and SIDES prices were typed as bare numbers directly in the description field (no currency markup) rather than the price field — read at face value as dollar amounts since each of those items has no other description text. Dropped 'MAKE IT AMERICAN' add-on modifiers (ADD BURRATA +8 etc, a la carte surcharges not standalone dishes), Lasagna del Giorno and Soup of the Day (no price, 'ask your server'), and *GLUTEN FREE CRUST/PASTA surcharge lines.
